architecture.B2_ADDITIVE: global visible mean + four visible-only site-state effects
architecture.B3_RAW_PAIR: B2 + mean of six visible-only pair residuals
architecture.B5_LIGHTNING: geometric mean of 4 within-site state percentiles and 6 within-pair residual percentiles, multiplied by 1-population-std(view scores)
architecture.SHUFFLED_B5: same B5 after deterministic circular permutation of visible fitness

decision_rule.B5_specific_advantage: B5 must also beat B3 raw-pair on prespecified design-selection metrics; otherwise the effective transferable core is attributed to pairwise/resonance structure rather than the full B5 consensus.
decision_rule.strong_transfer: B5 has strong enrichment over random and shuffled controls
